type ReturnsAny = (...args: any[]) => any;
function notKey<T extends ReturnsAny>(object: ReturnType<T>) {
  const key: keyof ReturnType<T> = false;
}
function unbounded<T>(object: T) {
  const key: keyof T = 'name';
}
function explicitAny<T extends any>(object: T) {
  const key: keyof T = 'name';
}
function unknownIndex<T extends { object: unknown }>(source: T) {
  const key: keyof T['object'] = 'name';
}
function typed<T extends () => { name: string }>(object: ReturnType<T>) {
  const key: keyof ReturnType<T> = 'different';
}
function conditional<T>(object: T extends string ? any : { name: string }) {
  const key: keyof typeof object = 'different';
}
